payload.value:
APNs, FCM, and Web Push are now all documented push-adapter surfaces. Web Push has the package subpath export, CLI VAPID provisioning (`frick tenants set-push --platform webpush`), PushSubscription validation, and RFC 8291 encrypted payloads when browser keys are present.

Remaining gap: push credential rotation still requires re-saving every tenant credentials with the new key; there is no multi-key overlap/decryption window yet.

Target: zero-downtime multi-key push credential rotation while preserving the documented adapter/CLI surfaces.
